builder_log.text:
BUILD INTENT: THE ARMATURE — phased growth under one permanent roof

OPERATION: Build the durable thing first: a five-bay frame and one roof, standing over the slope. Enclose two bays now. The rest is covered territory that becomes rooms later WITHOUT cutting into the original roof.

REFERENCE IT COMES FROM: Rev. Walker's Home — ~500 sf initial house under a ~1,900 sf five-bay shelter

DO NOT COPY: The Alabama vernacular, the gable, the porch detailing. The transferable thing is the sequence, not the look.
THE TEST THIS SCHEME MUST PASS: Can a mountain skeleton, roof and service artery make Phase 1 a complete house while creating protected future bays?
Plan authored and machine-checked. 1 levels, 22 rooms accepted by tools/build-plans.mjs; 5 flags raised.
Built in 3D from that plan by tools/render/lib/build3d.mjs and rendered. 23 parts. 616 sf conditioned, 184 lf perimeter, 22 lf wet wall, 197 CY cut.
